messages:
redwood-incident-bot: PAGE: infra-auth-high for customer: HavenRock (private VPC). Multiple token introspection failures observed across dedicated pool dc-us-east-3 starting 2025-03-10T09:47:05Z. Impact: API auth failures leading to 5xx for a subset of tenant requests. Paging on-call: @alice, @samir.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20250310-1142 / Priority: P1 / channel: #incidents. Runbook: vpc-oidc-mtls-fallback.

Alice Yang: ack. I'm on it, digging into auth-bridge logs for havenrock tenant.

Samir Patel: seeing repeated errors in the auth-bridge: 
```
2025-03-10T09:47:14Z ERROR auth-bridge: introspection POST https://auth.havenrock.internal/introspect -> 503 Service Unavailable
2025-03-10T09:47:14Z WARN jwks-cache: no matching kid for token kid=Zx7A4, cached_kids=[K1a2b, K1a2c]
```

Alice Yang: interesting — introspection 503 + jwks mismatch. Could be a half-rolled key rotation on their OIDC provider. HavenRock SRE, can you confirm any key rotations in your auth service? @havenrock-sre

havenrock-sre: yes, we rotated signing keys at 09:44 UTC as part of a scheduled key-roll. We intended to publish both old and new keys to JWKS but our deployment skipped a job and old key omitted. Tokens minted shortly before rotation still present in clients.

Samir Patel: that matches. Our auth-bridge calls introspection for session tokens when cached JWKS don't contain the kid; their introspection endpoint is erroring (503) because the rotation job also temporarily disabled the introspection service for a DB migration. So two failure modes: missing JWKS entry and introspection being down.

Alice Yang: outline mitigation options: 1) request HavenRock to re-publish old key to JWKS endpoint (fast if they can run a small job); 2) we can modify auth-bridge to accept cached JWKS from last-known-good for 10m and avoid introspection; 3) route traffic to fallback region/dedicated pool with cached keys. Preference: get them to publish the old key immediately, while we apply a short-term bypass to reduce retries to introspection and accept cached JWKS for in-flight tokens.

havenrock-sre: we can push old key back to JWKS now. Doing that. ETA ~5m. We'll also see if introspection can be brought back earlier than planned.

SRE Rotation: handing off to @Tilly (next on-call) in 10min for operations and customer comms. Tilly, I'll post notes and open a targeted rollback for the rotation job.

Tilly Ramos: taking over. Summary: JWKS missing old kid; introspection endpoint 503 due to migration; immediate mitigations: accept cached JWKS for 15 minutes, reduce introspection retries; push old key to JWKS. I'll coordinate with HavenRock for validation and open an ops runbook.

Alice Yang: implementing temporary auth-bridge patch now: flip config flag `auth_bridge.use_cached_jwks_if_introspect_unavailable = true` for tenant havenrock on pool dc-us-east-3 and dc-us-east-2. Will deploy to pool-3 canary 10%.

Infra Eng Bot: Deploy started: roll (auth-bridge-config) -> pool dc-us-east-3 canary=10% by Alice Yang (deploy-1234).

Samir Patel: while that's rolling, I'm adding an additional backoff and reducing introspect QPS to lower load on their introspection service if it comes back (avoid thundering herd).

havenrock-sre: old key published to https://auth.havenrock.internal/.well-known/jwks.json. Confirmed.

Alice Yang: saw the key. Validating tokens locally: the previously failing tokens now validate against the republished JWKS. Canary shows error rate drop from 32% -> 4% for the canary traffic subset.

Tilly Ramos: good. Alice, can you ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics look stable for 2 minutes per step? Also open a communications thread to HavenRock customer success.

Alice Yang: ramping to 50%. Metrics at 50% stable: errors ~2.8% down from 32%. Proceeding to 100%.

Infra Eng Bot: Deploy succeeded: config flip applied to pool dc-us-east-3 (100%): deploy-1234 -> success.

Samir Patel: monitoring logs for a residual spike. Also instrumented a short-lived metric: "auth.introspect.failover.count" for this tenant.

Tilly Ramos: contacting HavenRock SRE for post-incident check. @havenrock-sre any chance introspection migration caused a longer lasting 503 window? If so, we should coordinate a small change to our runbook to avoid blocking customer traffic on introspect availability.

havenrock-sre: migration was supposed to be <2m but a lock contention extended it. We're adding a pre-check to avoid disabling introspection before JWKS publish in the future. Apologies for impact.

Alice Yang: customer-facing summary draft: "We observed authentication failures for HavenRock customers between 09:47-09:56 UTC due to a partial key rotation on HavenRock's OIDC provider combined with a short outage of their introspection endpoint. Root cause: old signing key was not published to JWKS during rotation and introspection temporarily returned 503 during maintenance. Mitigation: HavenRock republished the old key; we temporarily enabled cached JWKS fallback in the auth-bridge and reduced introspection retries. Service restored by 09:56 UTC. Next steps: add a validation step for JWKS availability in their rotation job and we will add a config to avoid mandatory introspection for short windows when cached keys are available." 

SRE Rotation: marking incident as mitigated. Please post final severity.

Tilly Ramos: severity = P1 -> Customer impact: partial customer outage for a single enterprise tenant (HavenRock) — Auth failures causing elevated 5xx for ~9 minutes. We're moving to postmortem window. Action items: 1) Alice - revert cached-JWKS flag after HavenRock confirms long-term fix (ETA: 48h), 2) Samir - add circuit breaker to introspection with exponential backoff and jitter, 3) Product Ops - notify sales/CS.

oncall-bot: Handoff complete: owner=Tilly Ramos, incident state=Mitigated, timeline recorded, follow-ups assigned.

Alice Yang: pushing a follow-up PR (link: https://git.redwood.internal/patches/1234) to make cached-jwks fallback opt-in per-tenant with automatic expiry (30m). Will request rollback in 48h after confirmation.

havenrock-sre: thanks for fast help. We'll add a preflight step and ensure JWKS includes previous keys for a 1h overlap window in future rotations.

Tilly Ramos: closing thread for now. Will open an internal postmortem and customer-facing incident summary with CS. If anyone sees regression re-open. :white_check_mark:
